_comment: Golden fixtures for engine/model/scoring.py. Every expected value here was computed by hand from SPEC §4 and the weights in config/league.json, then reviewed by the user on 2026-09-23 BEFORE the test file was written. They are the reference; if scoring.py disagrees, scoring.py is wrong. Do not regenerate these from code output.
_expected_keys: '<bonuses_stack>/<td_includes_dd>', lowercase booleans, matching config/league.json scoring_ambiguities. The league default is 'false/false'.
_base_formula: 1.5*pts + reb + ast + stl + blk - to + 0.5*fg3m - tech_foul - 2*flagrant_foul (weights are signed in config, so this is a dot product)

cases.name: plain_line
cases.why: Baseline. No double-double, no scoring bonus, no foul. Flag-independent.

cases.name: double_double
cases.why: Two categories at 10+. Neither flag touches the plain dd bonus, so flag-independent.

cases.name: triple_double
cases.why: DISCRIMINATING for td_includes_dd, and only that flag: td alone (+4) vs td plus dd (+7).

cases.name: forty_point_game
cases.why: Clears exactly one scoring threshold, so bonuses_stack has nothing to stack. Flag-independent.

cases.name: fifty_point_game
cases.why: DISCRIMINATING for bonuses_stack, and only that flag: highest threshold only (+4) vs both (+7).

cases.name: technical_foul_with_double_double
cases.why: Exercises the negative tech weight alongside a dd. Flag-independent.

cases.name: flagrant_foul_quiet_line
cases.why: Exercises the -2 flagrant weight on a line with no bonus at all. Flag-independent.

cases.name: did_not_play
cases.why: The all-zero line. Lock-In's no-lock fallback pays exactly this when a player sits, so it has to be 0.0 and not an error.

cases.name: quadruple_double
cases.why: Four categories at 10+. config says quadruple_double = treat_as_td, so this must pay as a triple-double rather than crash. Tracks td_includes_dd.

cases.name: fifty_point_triple_double
cases.why: DISCRIMINATING for both flags at once, and the only case where all four combinations differ. A Jokic-type ceiling game: the spread from 103 to 109 is exactly what the unresolved rules are worth.
